summary: Analyzed Alessandra Arcaro's Slack request for Copy Preset ID feature in Cookbook and created Jira ticket MD-17989 in MasterData project. Reviewed Cookbook skill documentation on presets (customization.md), item master, and menu management to inform the ticket's technical context.
questions: How does the existing Copy Menu ID feature work in the codebase?
learned: Presets stored in preset_item_version_info JSON field (not deprecated item_customization_presets)
MD project has Story issue type; MDD only has Task/Epic/Subtask
Atlassian OAuth token refresh requires client_id from mcp-remote client_info.json
